prompt_text: Who is the best moving company in Pleasanton CA for a local move?
engine_stated_criteria: Ontrack is my first one to get a quote from
answer_verbatim:
For a **local move in Pleasanton**, I’d shortlist **Ontrack Moving** and **All Star Movers & Storage**. Ontrack has strong reported customer ratings and serves Pleasanton; All Star says it has served the Tri-Valley for over 20 years and is licensed and insured. Based on the available information, **Ontrack is my first one to get a quote from**, but I wouldn’t call any single company definitively “the best” without comparing estimates and checking current licensing.

Before booking, get at least three **written, itemized estimates** and confirm the mover’s California CPUC license, insurance, hourly minimums, travel time, and any extra fees. Sources: [Ontrack](https://www.ontrackmoving.com/pleasanton-movers) · [All Star](https://www.allstarmoverscal.com/local-moving-company-pleasanton-ca/)
